name: Rum
siboNotes: Pure distilled rum is FODMAP-free, but alcohol can irritate sensitive digestive systems and may worsen SIBO symptoms by affecting gut motility.
preparationTips: Choose plain, unflavored rum to avoid added sugars or flavorings
Avoid rum-based cocktails with high-FODMAP mixers like apple juice or coconut cream
Consume in moderation as alcohol can disrupt gut bacteria balance
Mix with low-FODMAP mixers like lime juice, soda water, or small amounts of cranberry juice
alternatives: Low-FODMAP mocktails with lime and soda water
nutritionalHighlights: No carbohydrates or FODMAPs when pure
Should be consumed in moderation due to alcohol content
